_comment: WHOIS REGISTRANT NOISE — values that appear in a registrant field but are NOT the owner: privacy proxies, registrar role mailboxes, redaction placeholders. Linking on one of these merges every domain at that registrar into a single bogus operator, and (for reverse-WHOIS) burns credits on a query that returns thousands of unrelated domains. This is WebPivot's COLLECTOR-side copy; the KB's analyst-side copy is tools/kb/references/registrant_noise.json. Keep new providers in sync across both — tests/test_references.py reports divergence.

privacy_markers._comment: Substrings that mark a registrant NAME/ORG value as a privacy proxy or redaction. Matched as a case-insensitive substring of the whole value. Consumed by whois_enrich.is_privacy(), which gates whether a registrant is worth a reverse-WHOIS at all.

role_email_prefixes._comment: Email LOCAL-PART prefixes (including the '@') of registrar role mailboxes. A role mailbox is the registrar's, never the registrant's. Consumed by whois_enrich.is_privacy().

proxy_email_domains._comment: Email DOMAINS operated by a privacy/proxy service or a registrar. Any address at one of these fronts an unknown number of unrelated registrants. Consumed by whois_enrich.is_privacy().

noise_email_substrings._comment: Substrings anywhere in a registrant EMAIL that mark it as registrar/privacy boilerplate. Consumed by evidence_report's cluster report so a shared proxy address never drives a same-operator judgment in a deliverable.

noise_name_substrings._comment: Substrings anywhere in a registrant NAME that mark it as a proxy placeholder rather than a person. Consumed by evidence_report's cluster report.
